overview_description.description:
Fawry is a pioneering Electronic Payment Network, offering financial services to consumers and businesses through more than 65 thousand locations and a variety of channels. It offers a convenient and reliable way to pay bills and other services  in multiple channels (online, using ATMs , mobile wallets and retail points)

The company's network of retailers includes small groceries, pharmacies and stationaries, and post-offices, all equipped with point-of-sale machines – the same ones used for credit card payments.

about_short_description.short_description: Fawry is a pioneering Electronic Payment Network, offering financial services to consumers and businesses

product.name: Fawry Electronic Payment Network
product.description: A nationwide electronic payment infrastructure that enables consumers and businesses to pay bills, purchase services, and process transactions through digital channels, points of sale, and agent locations.

product.name: Fawry Accept
product.description: A merchant payment acceptance service for processing online and in-store card and digital payments through payment gateways, point-of-sale solutions, and related transaction tools.

product.name: myFawry
product.description: A consumer-facing digital payment application for paying bills, recharging mobile and internet services, purchasing digital services, and managing electronic payments.

product.name: Fawry Agent and Point-of-Sale Services
product.description: A network of agent locations and point-of-sale terminals that enables in-person bill payment, account recharge, service purchases, and other electronic transactions.

product.name: Fawry Business Solutions
product.description: Business payment and collection services that help merchants, billers, and organizations accept payments, collect receivables, and manage transaction reporting and reconciliation.

product.name: Fawry Financial Services
product.description: Financial services delivered through Fawry’s electronic payment infrastructure, including access to selected payment-linked, lending, insurance, or other financial products for consumers and businesses.
